title.narrative: Increased capacity to implement energy components of NDCs.
Gap analysis and capacity action plan for selected SIDS/topics is implemented.

target.value: Continue implementation of technical advisory services and capacity building and report on results in terms of uptake and follow-up action

actual.value: Antigua and Barbuda: revised NDC submitted to UNFCCC. Belize10: Energy data audit was produced, with recommendations for how to improve energy data for GHG/NDC reporting. A statistical calendar was also developed to institutionalise data collection for MRV. Dominica: Draft data gaps report. Dominican Republic11: Current energy-related GHG calculations have been reviewed and recommendations made for their improvement. Also, IRENA is supporting MRV development, including the calculation of national GHG emissions factors. Fiji: Provided comments on the draft Climate Change Bill, which will institutionalise data collection for GHG reporting in the future. IRENA also assisted in identifying the data gaps and reviewed the methodology for energy statistics to support the MRV process. Grenada: Training modules and manuals on energy audit and management. IRENA also produced energy data gaps report. MRV was developed jointly with Global Growth Institute (GGI) for energy and waste sectors, and training on the MRV was delivered in March 2021. Papua New Guinea12: Provided input to Papua New Guineas NDC to ensure it meets the UNFCCC requirements. IRENA also supported the energy technical working group meetings in the country during the drafting process. IRENA is now supporting energy data collection for future GHG-NDC reporting and development and institutionalisation of their MRV system. Saint Kitts and Nevis: Revised NDC St. Vincent and the Grenadines: Presented draft MRV report to country. Tonga: Presented final MRV report to the country, including a simple tool developed for monitoring and reporting on Tongas NDC energy target.

target.value: Assessments and action plan developed identifying key capacity needs forselected SIDS RE/topics. Technical advisory services and capacity building implemented based on action plan.

actual.value: Dominican Republic, Papua New Guinea, and Grenada submitted enhanced NDCs based on IRENA analysis and Renewable Readiness Assessments and acknowledged IRENA contribution in this regard

target.value: Continue implementation of technical advisory services and capacity building and report on results in terms of uptake

actual.value: The regulatory gap analysis for Fijis energy sector is in progress with the draft report used for stakeholder consultation being planned for 2024 in particular the Ministry of Public Enterprise, which is under the Office of the Prime Minister, the Energy Fiji Limited (power utility), Fijian Competition & Consumer Commission (regulatory authority). This will be followed by a public consultation before the recommendations are tabled in Parliament for implementation.

actual.value: IRENA operationalised the Climate Investment Platform that offers an avenue for projects from the SIDS context to receive project support and technical assistance

target.value: Project facilitation tools, and tailored solutions and services have contributed to RE uptake in SIDS by supporting a solid pipeline of projects and facilitating their access to finance.

actual.value:
The SolarCity Simulators Simulators are now available for Sao Tome and Principe, Solomon Islands, and Belize (Belize City, San Ignacio, San Pedro), as well as Comoros (Moroni, Mutsamudu, Fomboni).
Training Workshops Workshops on using the SolarCity Simulator were held in Mauritius (Feb 2022), Sao Tome and Principe (in person, 30 participants), Solomon Islands (in person, 20 participants), Belize (online, 63 participants), Comoros (online, 22 participants), and Mauritius again (online, 68 participants). A webinar was also delivered during an event by the World Resource Institute.
Site Assessments IRENA supported Montserrat in evaluating five sites for a 20 MW onshore wind project, aligned with national tax and infrastructure plans. Site assessment services expanded to cover solar and wind (onshore, offshore, and floating) technologies. Methods were validated by DNV and EMD International, with over 98 percent accuracy.
Updated reports are used to present findings to countries. In Solomon Islands, IRENA developed an application to identify hydropower potential, supporting development beyond the 15 MW Tina River project. IRENA also assessed the techno-economic potential for utility-scale solar and wind in SIDS to support national energy planning.
Dissemination The simulator was presented at several events, including COP27, regional NDC forums, and capacity-building events. It is featured on the OECS website and Global Solar Council platform. The simulator has been translated into French (Comoros, Mauritius, Seychelles) and Spanish (Belize) to increase accessibility. A video was also produced to explain site assessment services and their benefits for project development in SIDS.

title.narrative: More robust and sustainable renewables sector development, with support to project development31 and facilitation of access to finance for renewable energy projects
The extent to which institutions/key actors supported through project facilitation tools and services have boosted investment in RE in SIDS

target.value: SIDS have access to project development tools and access to finance to meet the 5 GW target for RE

actual.value: As of N/A2023, the total renewable energy installed capacity stands at 8.7 GW. Contributing to further instalment of GW, project facilitation support was provided to 17 projects in 2023 during the Investment Forum in Barbados. As an example, Vanuatu in specific was supported with the technical assistance for Project Identification and Development and concept notes and project proposals are being developed and in the process of being submitted to financing institutions.

title.narrative: Institutional and technical capacity increased leading to improved enabling environment for renewables in SIDS

The extent to which the institutions/stakeholders in SIDS that received technical assistance and capacity building have been able to use that capacity to increase RE share in line with their NDC targets

target.value: Participating SIDS have improved institutional and technical capacity to increase the share of RE in line with NDC targets (on track for meeting the 5 GW RE target). 50% of SIDS have 100% renewable power roadmaps to 2030.

title.narrative: Partnerships within SIDS and with development partners and global energy initiatives strengthened

The proportion of participating SIDS benefiting from the collaborative platform andother efforts aimed at increased awareness and synergies between SIDS RE initiatives at country and regional levels and with global level initiatives

target.value: Over 60% of participating SIDS have benefitted from institutions andactors in their states that are making use of the collaborative platform and engage with other efforts that increase awareness and synergies.

actual.value: Increased number of SIDS LHI partners (41 SIDS and 50 partners) with recent joiners including Jamaica, Barefoot College, Global Solutions International Saint Kitts and Nevis and the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank The Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) also joined as a a SIDS LHI partner and currently drafting a Letter of cooperation to strengthen collaboration that will facilitate energy transition support for Indian Ocean SIDS. Continuous improvement and update of the IRENA Islands website ensuring SIDS and partners have access to all SIDS related IRENA publications, Events, Data and latest news and updates. Ensured that SIDS and partners remain informed on the latest energy sector developments by consistently disseminating information, including newly published reports, financial support opportunities, and other relevant updates, via email and social media channels
